#| code-fold: show
train_model(autoencoder, ae_loss)
with torch.no_grad():
    ae_mse = F.mse_loss(autoencoder(x_test), x_test).item()
    ae_codes = autoencoder.encoder(x_train)

Yes.
Its mean squared error per pixel is `r sprintf("%.3f", py$ae_mse)`,
against `r sprintf("%.3f", py$mean_mse)` for the mean image.
Two numbers per image carry about half of what separates the test images from the mean image.
